summary: WatchNexus v2.6.5 - All 3 user-reported issues verified fixed. 11/11 backend tests passed, all frontend UI tests passed.

fix_1_gadgets_proper_names_icons.details: GET /api/ripen/installed returns 10 gadgets with proper names (Weather, Podcasts, Internet Radio, etc.) and colored category icons

fix_1_gadgets_required_fields.details: Each gadget has gadget_id, name, version, status, category, description fields

fix_1_gadgets_valid_categories.details: All gadgets have valid categories: weather, audio, image, video, notification, metadata, system, game, service

fix_2_toggle_deactivate_persists.details: POST /api/ripen/deactivate/weather persists to DB, GET /api/ripen/installed shows status='inactive'

fix_2_toggle_activate_persists.details: POST /api/ripen/activate/weather persists to DB, GET /api/ripen/installed shows status='active'

fix_2_toggle_roundtrip.details: Full toggle cycle works: active -> inactive -> active with persistence

fix_3_no_jellyfin_in_crumbs.details: Jellyfin is NOT in /api/crumbs/services (removed from registry)

fix_3_gadgets_category_correct.details: Gadgets category contains only: openweathermap, matrix, synapse

frontend_gadgets_installed_display.details: Gadgets > Installed shows 10 gadgets with colored icons, proper names, category badges

frontend_gadget_toggle_deactivate.details: Clicking Weather switch: status changes to 'Inactive', switch changes to off (aria-checked=false)

frontend_gadget_toggle_activate.details: Clicking Weather switch again: status changes to 'Active', switch changes to on (aria-checked=true)

frontend_api_management_no_jellyfin.details: API Management > Gadgets section shows NO Jellyfin service entry

critical_code_review_comments: RipenController correctly implements DB-persisted activate/deactivate using ripen_disabled_gadgets setting
Gadgets now have proper gadget_id, name, version, category, description fields for frontend icon/badge display
CrumbsController registry correctly excludes Jellyfin (11 services, gadgets category has only openweathermap, matrix, synapse)
GadgetContext auto-refreshes after login via polling for token changes
context_for_next_testing_agent: v2.6.5 user-reported issues all verified fixed. Fix 1: Gadgets now show proper names/icons/descriptions from /api/ripen/installed with gadget_id, category, description fields. Fix 2: Toggle persistence works via ripen_disabled_gadgets DB setting (deactivate adds to set, activate removes). Fix 3: Jellyfin removed from /api/crumbs/services registry (now 11 services, gadgets category has openweathermap, matrix, synapse only). Frontend Settings correctly shows 'Users' label and gadget toggles work with immediate status/switch state updates.
